question: Should OpenClaw re-sync from current `openclaw/agent-skills`, or should the multi-pass implementation first be restored and approved in that canonical repository before this vendored snapshot lands?
rationale: The repository contract makes agent-skills canonical, but this branch currently contains behavior absent from canonical main; choosing to pin a divergent snapshot rather than restore upstream ownership requires explicit maintainer intent.

options.title: Restore upstream, then sync
options.body: Re-land and validate multi-pass review in `openclaw/agent-skills`, then regenerate this snapshot from the approved upstream SHA.

options.title: Intentionally pin the snapshot
options.body: Document why OpenClaw must temporarily diverge, record the pinned upstream provenance, and define when the copies will reconverge.

options.title: Pause this change
options.body: Keep the current 180 KB fail-closed behavior until the canonical implementation and operational tradeoffs are settled.

recommendation.title: Restore upstream, then sync
recommendation.body: Re-land and validate multi-pass review in `openclaw/agent-skills`, then regenerate this snapshot from the approved upstream SHA.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the current PR and dominate the merged history of the canonical autoreview implementation, so they can resolve whether the upstream divergence is intentional.
